visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Smaller Value Is Returned
visualizerParams.problemDescription: larger should return the bigger value (8, pear, 2.5), but the program prints the smaller ones.

solution.explanation: compareTo returns a positive number or zero when a is not smaller than b, so in that case a is the larger value and must be the one returned. Swapping the branches returns the smaller value every time.
